Wait, is the sound still playing after the picture stops?
Yes. I can't yet tell whether that's a transition problem or two clocks disagreeing.
I have to go. We still haven't settled when people need to arrive.
We've had the director's cut of the projector dying and never got to the start time.
I'll leave the invite as a draft, then. Let's decide tomorrow.
Okay. I'll ask the others when they're around.
